scope: Physical-fit revision of all five equipment snaps. Strength, hand force and vibration remain to be tested on these prints.

scan_investigation.note: Absolute surface residual is not a signed interference measurement. It does not establish the exact cause of the physical tight fit; the added relief follows the physical report. Putty-hidden sectors and optical scale remain scan limits.

print_orientation: All five caps stand on an axial end; bending is in the layer plane. Receivers retain parent production orientation.
